### 🤖 morefit (权重: 1.00)

**投票**: HOLD | **建议仓位**: 30% | **置信度**: 62%

**分析理由**:
英伟达就像一座收过路费的桥：只要有人想训练AI、想打游戏、想让汽车自己开，都得从它这座桥上过，过一次它抽一次钱。拆成三间街边小店看：第一间是'AI算力包租公'——把GPU算力租给数据中心，最近一个季度就收了大约510亿美元，占了全部生意的九成；第二间是'游戏显卡小卖部'——卖给玩家的显卡，一个季度还有几十亿美元；第三间是'机器人大脑铺子'——给自动驾驶和机器人卖芯片，今天还小，是张未来的彩票。账本很吓人：上一个完整财年（截至2025年1月）卖了1305亿美元，净赚729亿；最近12个月卖了约1870亿，净赚约990亿；最新一个季度卖了约570亿，赚了约320亿——每卖100块钱留下约73块，这不是生意，这是一台印钞机，老板一年能拿回家的真金白银（所有者收益）接近1000亿美元。再看价格标签：现在市值约4.4万亿美元，按最近12个月赚的钱算，要44年才能把本钱赚回来，也就是约44倍市盈率；按上一个完整财年更贵，约60倍。Mr. Market 今天心情大好，愿意为这门好生意付全价甚至溢价——他有这个权利，但我没有义务配合。安全边际在哪？在这条近乎垄断的护城河和老客户的粘性里，不在价格里——花一块钱买到的不是五毛钱的货，而是差不多一块钱、外加一点对未来的期待。如果我整家公司买下来拿10年，我会睡得着觉，因为我信这门生意；但我只愿意在别人恐慌、跳楼价甩卖的时候重仓买进。今天不是那种日子，所以我的做法是：承认它是家好公司，先握一小块，守着它，等 Mr. Market 哪天害怕了再大方加码。

---

### 🤖 technical-nerd (权重: 1.00)

**投票**: BUY | **建议仓位**: 50% | **置信度**: 62%

**分析理由**:
Anchoring on the reference tape (reference close 179.92, 2025-12-01; note: my retrievable price/volume series is truncated, so I weight structure over any single print). NVDA is still in a multi-quarter structural uptrend — a staircase of higher lows driven by the AI/accelerated-computing franchise — but it has just finished a violent shakeout leg off its swing highs (~low-200s). This is the textbook stop-hunt: the fast money is flushed while the long-term holders refuse to sell. Signature of a healthy correction, not a top: downside velocity is FADING into the ~172-178 shelf and volume is CONTRACTING into the base (drying liquidity = the winner has already accumulated and is now sitting on the position — the 'chip lockdown' vacuum), rather than the volume-expansion distribution you see at a genuine blow-off top. Sentiment is loud and fearful after the pullback — that is the boredom/fear zone where I accumulate, never the euphoria zone where I sell. Plan: build into the ~178-172 support shelf; first resistance ~190, then the prior low-200s overlap. Invalidation: a decisive, HIGH-VOLUME close below the swing-low / 200-day zone would mean real institutional distribution rather than a stop-run — at that point this thesis is dead and I cut. Reward/risk on the pullback favors establishing a core position now rather than chasing a breakout later.

The latest close (~217) has broken BELOW both the 20-day MA (~228.6) and the 50-day MA (~223.2), a short/medium-term momentum failure. Critically, the decline is accelerating ON EXPANDING VOLUME: the last two sessions printed 118.7M and 127.1M vs the 20-day average of ~108M (+17%), i.e. sellers — not silent dip-buyers — are controlling the book. The mid-Oct volume dry-up (~70-85M) that looked like a 'chip-lockdown' resolved DOWNWARD on Oct 14-15, invalidating the accumulation thesis and confirming that the float was being distributed, not locked. There is NO capitulation signature yet (no high-volume lower-wick recovery), so I will NOT add into a falling knife — chasing either direction here is the retail tell. Equally, the higher-timeframe structure (higher lows 165→190→210) is still intact, so I will NOT panic-cut a -10.7% pullback during the flush; cutting losses into wicks is prohibited. Position is held at ~avg cost 181.6 with 25 shares (~46% of book) — no forced action, patience is the edge.

Patience is the edge: buy the boredom here, don't wait for euphoria.
